Field-note sheet area: Top metadata block (ID / client / address / insp type / due time)
Example / interpretation from sample fie: Preprinted office metadata is visible at the top of both sample field-note sheets.
Candidate digital input(s): Inspector_name; inspection_id; file_number; client_name; jrp_job_number; client_job_number; address; lot_block_plan; inspection_type; eng_fill; time_due
Notes: Supports the future prepopulation story. These are office/booking-system inputs, not handwritten field observations.

Example / interpretation from sample fie: Sample printed comments mention sulphate, spread footing capacity, and design notes before handwritten observations begin.
Notes: Useful as carried-forward context or alert banner, not as primary technical logic.

Example / interpretation from sample fie: Sample note includes handwritten soil shorthand like clay / silty / moist / brown-grey / high plastic.
Candidate digital input(s): soil_layering_mode; soil_origin; material_family; moisture; colour; plasticity; traces; high_plastic; and more that should be fully captured…
Notes: This is one of the most important future data-capture areas for the UI.

Field-note sheet area: Cut/fill sketch grid with corner notes
Example / interpretation from sample fie: The sketch and handwritten cut/fill numbers are the source for min/max cut values and often reveal garage/walkout context.
Candidate digital input(s): cut_frontleft_m; cut_frontright_m; cut_backleft_m; cut_backright_m; garage_mode; walkout
Notes: Current manual practice uses the lowest and highest cuts recorded around the sketch to inform the FSI letter from the four captured values.

Example / interpretation from sample fie: The form explicitly asks whether ingressing water is present.
Notes: Strong candidate for a clean checkbox in the future UI.

Example / interpretation from sample fie: Short handwritten recommendation note appears below ingressing water.
Notes: Useful as a QA cross-check, but the generator should derive recommendations from structured conditions instead of relying on free text.

Example / interpretation from sample fie: The printed form includes an Attached Garage checkbox.
Notes: Directly maps to whether garage excavation and garage recommendation logic should appear.

Example / interpretation from sample fie: The printed form includes a Walkout checkbox.
Notes: Useful because walkout replaces the standard cut wording.

Example / interpretation from sample fie: Sample handwritten comments include client job shorthand and 'No garage'.
Notes: In the current paper process, this box often carries the clues that drive garage/walkout selection.

Field-note sheet area: Front-left / front-right / back-left / back-right note lines
Example / interpretation from sample fie: Printed location lines sit under the grid for corner-specific notes.
Notes: The min and max values captured here from the 4 corner values will be utilized in the FSI letter build.

Example / interpretation from sample fie: Printed operational tracking fields appear below recommendations.
Candidate digital input(s): operational_contact_tracking: text, voice mail, talked to contact, gave recommendations to cribber
Notes: Operational workflow only; not part of the V1 letter generator.

Example / interpretation from sample fie: Hazard rank, hazards, and controls are filled by hand on the sample sheets.
Candidate digital input(s): site_hazard_assessment: rank, existing or potential hazard description, hazard control
Notes: Relevant to field workflow digitization, not to V1 report assembly.

Example / interpretation from sample fie: First aid, emergency number, first aid personnel, muster point, and emergency medical facility checkboxes appear at bottom left.
Notes: Keep for future inspection-app scope; not required for report generation.

Field-note sheet area: PPE / print name / sign / review lines
Example / interpretation from sample fie: PPE checkboxes (hard hat, safety boots, safety vests, other) and Eng/Tech,Other,Review print-name/sign lines appear at bottom right.
Notes: Important for digitized field workflow later, but outside the report-writer MVP.

Example / interpretation from sample fie: Top block is prefilled; lower technical fields are handwritten; safety/operational sections are always present on paper.
Notes: Confirms that the future UI should separate auto-filled metadata from engineer-entered observations.
